The *Ganthagocchaka* (Patthana 2.5) is a structural section of the *Paṭṭhāna* belonging to the *Dukapaṭṭhāna*, located within the Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. The text systematically applies the twenty-four conditional relations (*paccaya*) to the dyads (*duka*) governing the category of "ties" or "bonds" (*gantha*) [SuttaCentral]. None of the available secondary literature passages directly discuss this chapter of the *Paṭṭhāna*, instead focusing on the homonymous *Ganthagocchaka* chapter and mātikā of the *Dhammasaṅgaṇi*.
SuttaCentral notes no curated parallels for this text in other Buddhist canons [SuttaCentral].
